general.notes: Passive QSFP+ to QSFP+ copper DAC (4-channel full-duplex); not an optical transceiver. Copper link length up to 3 m (passive limiting). Standard ordering variants: 0 to +70°C case; Industrial (-40 to +85°C) part numbers suffixed with I. Recommended operating case temperature typical 25°C. Power supply +3.3 V. Storage temperature -40 to 85°C. Mechanical cable lengths 0.5, 1, 2, 3 m (30 AWG). Product Characteristics list electrical cable metrics (differential impedance 100±10 ohm, IL, NEXT ≥26 dB @ 10 MHz to 5.0 GHz, intra-pair skew ≤100 ps / ≤400 ps) not mapped to optical schema fields. reach_km derived from stated 3 m maximum copper length.
provenance_datasheet_sections: RoHS Compliant 40Gb/s QSFP+ to QSFP+ Copper Cable
general.suggestions: Consider reach_m or cable_length_m for DAC products; optional fields for supply voltage (3.3 V), passive/active media type, and per-channel electrical data rate range.
